# Vendored Typst templates

Copied unmodified from [Typst Universe](https://typst.app/universe) so that compiling
needs no network access. Each directory keeps its original `LICENSE` and `typst.toml`.

| Directory | Package | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| `basic-resume/` | basic-resume 0.2.10 | Unlicense | https://github.com/stuxf/basic-typst-resume-template |
| `letter-pro/` | letter-pro 3.0.0 | MIT | https://github.com/Sematre/typst-letter-pro |

## Fonts (`../fonts/`)

The fonts of the Mappe UI, used by the export report (`export.typ`). Static TTFs, unmodified,
each with its license.

| Font | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|
| Inter (Regular, Italic, Medium, SemiBold, Bold) | 4.1 | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/rsms/inter |
| Instrument Serif (Regular) | — | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/instrumentserif |
| JetBrains Mono (Regular, Bold) | 2.304 | OFL 1.1 | https://github.com/JetBrains/JetBrainsMono |
